official_findings.source: NARA RG59 Central Foreign Policy Files 1973-1979
official_findings.finding: The series contains electronic telegrams plus electronically indexed microfilmed hard-copy records; declassified telegrams and index information through 1979 are searchable by NARA tools.

official_findings.source: Foreign Relations of the United States / State Department historical record
official_findings.finding: By FY1976 roughly 1,708 DoD personnel were projected in Iran, with the increase attributed almost entirely to security-assistance activities; ARMISH/MAAG remained part of the U.S. military-assistance structure.

official_findings.source: Foreign Relations of the United States / State Department historical record
official_findings.finding: U.S. technical/advisory support had long included Iranian F-4 acquisition, training, maintenance/support functions and air-defense modernization, creating plausible U.S. reporting channels for operational or maintenance anomalies.

search_result.meaning: No event-specific RG59 telegram was recovered through the searched public web-indexed subset. This is NOT a claim that AAD/microfilm contains no such record.
